steps.description:
Did you notice that sound effects and visuals in video games often happen at the same time? This is called concurrency. It appears in many applications, such as messaging apps, where you and your friends can type at the same time.

For this exercise, we want to make a sound and text appear together. Below shows two ways to do it.






Display the following text and play an A4 note at the same time for 2 seconds.

The following shows two ways to make a text and sound appear concurrently.






                  

Create a Racing Car countdown sequence with sound effects:

  1. Display "3" at the top centre of the LCD and play a B4 note at the same time for 1 second.
  2. Display "2" at the top centre of the LCD and play a B4 note at the same time for 1 second.
  3. Display "1" at the top centre of the LCD and play a B4 note at the same time for 1 second.
  4. Display "Go" at the top centre of the LCD and play a B4 note at the same time for 1 second.
  5. Pause for 0.5 second between every step.
